channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says he won't use nuclear weapons or send ground troops to Iran
item.description: Trump said he would not use nuclear weapons against Iran or send ground troops as the U.S. reportedly weighs new strike options.

item.title: Fed's Warsh withholds rate signal, praises recent global tightening
item.description: Warsh refrained from signaling another interest rate hike this month, pointed to a "synchronous tightening" by central banks in the fight against inflation.

item.title: Tesla unveils long-delayed Roadster, showing off its flying-car ambitions
item.description: Elon Musk first debuted the Roadster refresh concept in 2017 but Tesla has since missed every targeted delivery date.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Tesla, SpaceX, Alcoa, CoreWeave, Travelers & more
item.description: These are the stocks posting the largest moves premarket.

item.title: Buy SpaceX ahead of earnings, says Evercore ISI
item.description: The investment firm has an outperform rating on SpaceX.

item.title: Norway's $2 trillion wealth fund was frozen out of major defense companies. That may be about to change
item.description: Existing ethical rules mean the fund is not permitted to invest in companies like Lockheed Martin and Boeing.

item.title: Europe's answer to SpaceX set for 25% weekly gain as Ukraine's Starshield limits raise concerns
item.description: Eutelsat's shares soared this week and continued climbing on Friday as its competitor Starshield drew criticism over its limitations in Ukraine.

item.title: KFC to switch to Coca-Cola beverages in U.S. restaurants for the first time in decades
item.description: KFC is switching from PepsiCo to Coca-Cola as its beverage supplier for U.S. restaurants.

item.title: U.S. Starlink curbs embolden Russia to intensify attacks on Ukraine, minister tells CNBC
item.description: Ukraine is seeking winter energy and air-defense support as Russian strikes intensify and Starlink limits disrupt military operations.

item.title: Russia returns to G20 table in Bangkok on U.S. invitation that angers Europe
item.description: Russia’s return to the G20 table has tested how far Washington’s outreach to Moscow will strain ties with European allies.
